baseline_total_sbc_pct_revenue.kind: new analyst decomposition, not original model input
baseline_total_sbc_pct_revenue.basis: FY2025 SBC/revenue54.267/707.630=7.6689%; H1 2026 27.339/387.574=7.0539%. Eight percent deliberately rounded analyst allowance, not guidance.

legacy_expense_runout_m.kind: analyst timing assumption based on disclosed total
legacy_expense_runout_m.basis: 138.3/2.4 straight-line assumption; weighted-average period does not establish actual schedule.

reported_unit_vesting_fraction.basis: Reported2.476181m units; full vesting example is not issuer guidance.

reported_units_already_in_common_m.basis: Exact common108.461603m; reported nonvested2.476181m. Explicit overlap prevents allocating any already-issued restricted shares twice.

residual_legacy_share_equivalents_m.kind: analyst net economic claim equivalent, not observed instrument count
residual_legacy_share_equivalents_m.basis: Unresolved granular PSU/options/ESPP.0.1m Q2 reserve is not fullcompany cap; largecase is stress not upper bound. Exercise/purchase proceeds and overlaps belong in net equivalent.

vesting_weights.kind: analyst timing, not actual vesting schedule
vesting_weights.basis: Equal firstthree-year settlement chosen solely for conditional planning; issuer has differing service and performance vesting.

withholding_fraction.basis: Not inferred from H1 amounts; settlement tax rates and stock prices vary.

residual_claim_cash_fraction.basis: Equity-only net residual equivalent in illustrations. Does not impose RSU withholding on options/ESPP.

marketable_securities_liquidity_haircut.basis: Cash87.720m plus securities737.228m; zero assumes availability at reported values. Cash-only stress suppresses unfunded valuation.

settlement_price_convention.basis: Algebraic claim/cash consistency; not forecast investment return.

assume_no_separate_legacy_tax_benefit.basis: Legacy expense removed after corporate tax, removing old shield; gross employee cash withholding remains untaxed in cashflow.
